name: 98922 · Cle Elum, WA
findings: ZIP 98922 (Cle Elum) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98922 (Cle Elum) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98922 (Cle Elum) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.
